topic: The ant colony that has been alive and running for 100 million years
hook: This ant colony has been alive for 100 million years.
script: This ant colony has been alive for 100 million years. Ants have existed since the time of dinosaurs. Individual ants live weeks. But colonies are effectively immortal — the queen reproduces continuously, workers rotate, and the superorganism persists. Some Argentine ant supercolonies stretch across continents. One network. Billions of individuals. One ancient mind. Follow for facts about creatures that outlived the dinosaurs.
